about_yourself_testimonial_anthony_troli: Wispr Flow can take ridiculous brainstorm sessions and instantly turn them into polished concepts that I can share with clients.
about_yourself_testimonial_aryaman_sharm: Flow is basically my brain dumb button. I dump all my chaotic thoughts, half ideas, random 2am brain sparks, and it just keeps up.
about_yourself_testimonial_codie_sanchez: I used to suck at getting 10,000 steps a day. Finally cracked the code, while working a lot, and getting a workout in. Do all your emails and writing while walking with Wispr Flow, voice-to-text only.
Founder and CEO of Contrarian Thinking
about_yourself_testimonial_jeff_seibert_: I was able to dictate ~70% of our Q2 board doc with Wispr, it was a massive time saver!
about_yourself_testimonial_mark_cuban_qu: Use Flow to stay ahead of the chaos and drive revenue rather than react to it.
about_yourself_testimonial_prajwal_tomar: I barely touch my keyboard anymore. Voice-to-text with Cursor / Claude Code has 10x my productivity.
about_yourself_testimonial_rahul_vohra_q: I'm at least 2-3x faster with Wispr Flow. It's saving me hours a day.
about_yourself_testimonial_rajiv_ayyanga: I started using Wispr Flow with Replit, and then started using it everywhere - it's really slick and fast.
about_yourself_testimonial_ron_kort_quot: I've tried most accessibility dictation software, and Wispr Flow absolutely blows them out of the water.
about_yourself_testimonial_trevor_jordan: Flow works everywhere and tidies up my speech leaving me with a clean, polished transcript. It has already become my exclusive dictation tool.
about_yourself_testimonial_yash_tekriwal: Once people really taste how much faster and better it is to dictate their thoughts, there's no way they're ever going back.
